FN-7TCX2V-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 78
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 78 as introduced would codify the current practice of the Board of Pharmacy
permitting entities providing pharmacy services instead of the permitting of persons. This bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
